summary: This document records the Iceberg Spark integration updates, covering new features such as DSv2 validation, geometry bounds in Parquet writers, and runtime filtering improvements, along with bug fixes for ORC variant handling and vectorized reads. The discussion centers on how to interpret Parquet files that contain field IDs for only some columns, a scenario that current implementations handle inconsistently. The thread discusses adding a batch signing endpoint to the REST catalog spec to support the new FILE type where each row may reference an external object. Participants highlight the need to include authorization context per element, potentially altering the request design to accommodate file reference permissions.
